builder.entitiesHint: Click to drop onto the floor, then drag it into place or fine-tune the exact numbers on the right.
builder.emptyFloorBody: Add a zone from the palette to block out your first section, then fill it with racks, platforms and pallet positions.

simple.name: Simple storage room
simple.description: One zone, two racks — good for a single room or small yard.

depotVertical.name: Full depot — vertical zones
depotVertical.description: 4 walled zones side by side, each with 3 two-level pallet racks, separated by aisles.

depotHorizontal.name: Full depot — horizontal zones
depotHorizontal.description: The same 4-zone racked depot, laid out in horizontal bands instead of vertical strips.

builder.templatesReplaceHint: Choosing a template replaces everything currently on this floor.
builder.addSectorHint: Adds one more zone, shrinking the existing ones to make room.
builder.confirmReplaceBody: Your subscription gives this facility one depot scheme. Applying a template replaces everything on the floor now and can't be undone — though you can always come back here and switch to a blank floor or another template later.
builder.nothingSelectedBody: Click an object to select it — drag to move, drag the corner to resize, or edit exact numbers on the right.
builder.label: Label
builder.floorSettingsBody: Resize the envelope this facility's blueprint is drawn on.
